subject: Wire the arena render tests into the smoke gate
description: _tools/hexos/flag-refusal-message.render.test.js (13/13, mutation-verified: exit 1 against the pre-fix engine) and _tools/hexos/board-box-slot.render.test.js are both TOOLs that NOTHING invokes, so the behaviour they protect is unguarded on every future deploy. Both are puppeteer + self-contained (stubbed callable, no emulator, no project), so they are wirable. Deliberately not wired on 2026-09-19 to avoid adding a browser test to the deploy path during a live deploy; that tradeoff was stated to the operator, not hidden.
